top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards a molecular invention, the reversible 3'-blocked nucleotide with a cleavable fluorophore read on clustered single molecules, whose mechanism is demonstrated at the molecular level and independently confirmed over fifteen years. The two-name Balasubramanian-Klenerman allocation is the cleanest on the slate; the priority claims of Rothberg, Mayer and Ju must be settled by expert reports and the citation must stay on the chemistry, not the platform. Degrader proposals follow because the ternary-complex mechanism is well evidenced, though no PROTAC drug is yet approved.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; mild collegial tie to Secretary Brzezinski at Stockholm University, not a basis for recusal on any slate laureate
